lines.text: Turbulent Timeways corrected: it is a six week event, Jun 30 to Aug 11, ending on Dragonflight Timewalking
Patch 12.1 estimate firmer: the PTR is flagged release candidate and PTR data slots the Tidebound Grotto raid lair for Aug 18
GO Fest Sunday Raid Makeup (Jul 26) expanded to all players worldwide with up to 12 free Raid Passes
Ultra Unlock anniversary event pass rewards must be claimed by Jul 29 at 7:59pm local

needs_you.action: Finish Ozone Ascent Timed Research and claim the Meteorite and Rayquaza rewards by 8pm local
Buy the Glimmers of Gratitude Masterwork Research ($4.99, Shiny Shaymin) before Ultra Unlock ends at 8pm local
Race Zorua's hide-and-sneak courses for the trophy before the event ends at 4:59am local
Finish the July Traveler's Log for the free Bilgewater X-TREME mount and spend or freeze Tender before the Aug 1 rollover
Claim GO Pass: July rewards by 10am local (rank earning ends Aug 4 at 10am)
Finish your remaining Turbulent Timeways weekly quests before the event ends Aug 11 to secure the Spawn of Vyranoth mount
Farm double-rate Illusionary Coins and spend them on Decor Duels rewards before patch 12.1 removes the event
Evolve Nickit by 9pm local on Community Day to get Thievul with Icy Wind

games.typical_lead_time: in-game calendar visible 4+ weeks out; shop and patch news 1-2 weeks

timeline.title: Turbulent Timeways V
timeline.detail: Run each week's featured Timewalking dungeons across the six week event and finish the meta before Aug 11 to claim the Spawn of Vyranoth mount, with the finale returning to Dragonflight Timewalking.

timeline.title: Trading Post: True-Blue Celebration
timeline.detail: Finish the Traveler's Log for the free Bilgewater X-TREME mount and spend or freeze Tender on items like the Wailing Banshee's Charger (575) before the month flips Aug 1.

timeline.title: Decor Duels: Final Surge
timeline.detail: Play Decor Duels in Silvermoon City for double Illusionary Coins and spend them before the mode is removed at Curse of Ula'tek; decor moves to Voidlight Marl vendors afterward.
timeline.estimate_basis: Removal confirmed at 12.1 launch; no announced date, PTR release candidate points to Aug 11

timeline.title: Last chance: Midnight Season 1
timeline.detail: Wrap up Season 1 goals (Keystone Master, elite PvP transmog, Mythic raid rewards) before Season 1 ends when patch 12.1 launches.
timeline.estimate_basis: Season 1 ends at patch 12.1; no announced date, Aug 11 is community projection from the release candidate PTR

timeline.title: Catch the Drift subscription promo
timeline.detail: Buy or hold a 6 or 12 month recurring subscription to receive the Sunflare Driftmoth skyriding mount and Sunflutter Driftmoth pet; no end date announced.

timeline.title: WoW BlizzCon 2026 Bundle
timeline.detail: Buy the bundle (Rabbit'ath Void mount, Garb of the Dawnfire Phoenix ensemble, Perch of the Dawnfire Phoenix housing decor) on the Battle.net Shop by Sep 28.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire
timeline.detail: Visit Darkmoon Island during the first week of August for tickets, profession quests, and the monthly carousel and top-hat buffs.

timeline.title: Trial of Style
timeline.detail: Queue for the transmog contest scenario to earn Trial of Style tokens for exclusive ensembles.

timeline.title: Trading Post: August rotation
timeline.detail: A new rotation arrives Aug 1 with a datamined western Showdown theme (gunslinger transmog and a horse mount); Blizzard's official item list is not yet posted.
timeline.estimate_basis: Rollover date is fixed; theme from datamining via Icy Veins, official August article not published as of Jul 24

timeline.title: Free T-Shirt Day (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Visit the vendor NPCs across Azeroth during this one-day micro-holiday to collect the free shirt cosmetics.

timeline.title: Patch 12.1: Curse of Ula'tek
timeline.detail: The next content update brings a new island zone, a new dungeon, instanced world bosses, and the Venomous Abyss raid, with PTR data slotting the Tidebound Grotto raid lair for Aug 18 and Season 2 close behind.
timeline.estimate_basis: PTR build flagged release candidate with no official date; community projects Aug 11 launch

timeline.title: Northrend Cup
timeline.detail: Fly Northrend skyriding race courses in Normal, Advanced, and Reverse modes for Riders of Azeroth Badges and cosmetics.

weekly_rhythm: Week of Jul 21: Classic Timewalking (Turbulent Timeways week 4) plus a Midnight Dungeon Event bonus week; PvP Brawl: Arathi Blizzard
Week of Jul 28: Burning Crusade Timewalking (TT week 5); Arena Skirmish Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Gravity Lapse; July Trading Post ends Jul 31
Week of Aug 4: Dragonflight Timewalking (TT finale, ends Aug 11); PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk; Darkmoon Faire and Trial of Style run Aug 1-8
Week of Aug 11: World Quest Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown; 12.1 expected this reset (unconfirmed); Free T-Shirt Day Aug 16
Week of Aug 18: Battleground Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble; Tidebound Grotto raid lair expected Aug 18 (unconfirmed)
Week of Aug 25: Pet Battle Bonus Event and Northrend Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible; Northrend Cup begins Aug 25
just_past_window: Sep 1-8: Delves Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Temple of Hotmogu
Sep 5-12: Darkmoon Faire (estimated from first-Saturday cadence)
Sep 8-15: PvP Brawl: Southshore vs Tarren Mill

games.typical_lead_time: events usually announced 1-4 weeks ahead; season schedule posted at season start

timeline.title: GO Pass: July
timeline.detail: Earn ranks through Aug 4 at 10am local for Ho-Oh at rank 100 and anniversary-coin Gimmighoul at ranks 101 and 200, then claim everything by Aug 6 at 10am; Deluxe $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks, uncapped GO Points Aug 1-2.

timeline.title: Ultra Unlock: 10th Anniversary Edition
timeline.detail: Catch Alola, Galar, and Paldea starters with 10x catch XP Jul 25-27, buy the Glimmers of Gratitude Masterwork Research ($4.99, Shiny Shaymin) before 8pm local Jul 27, and claim event pass rewards by Jul 29 at 7:59pm local.

timeline.title: Ozone Ascent
timeline.detail: Grab a free Meteorite and Rayquaza encounter from Timed Research to teach Dragon Ascent; all research expires Jul 26 at 8pm local, optional paid research $4.99.

timeline.title: GO Fest 2026 Sunday Raid Makeup
timeline.detail: Now global for all players: GO Fest Sunday raid bosses return in 3 hour habitat rotations plus Mega Mewtwo Y Super Mega Raids, with up to 12 free Raid Passes from Gym spins and no Remote Raid limit Jul 25-26.

timeline.title: Choose Your Path: Fairy Trail
timeline.detail: Pick one locked path (Explore, Catch, or Battle) that shapes your week of Timed Research, then finish it before Aug 3 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Gigantamax Rillaboom Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: Battle Gigantamax Rillaboom in 6-star Max Battles with Shiny G-Max Rillaboom debuting and 8x Max Particles from Power Spots; optional $4.99 ticket (in shop until 5pm) adds a Max Mushroom.

timeline.title: GO Pass: August
timeline.detail: Earn toward Latias encounters (shiny possible) and the Deluxe Lucky Trinket; Deluxe $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks, ranks close Sep 8 at 10am local, claim by Sep 10 at 10am, and the Trinket must be used by Sep 13.

timeline.title: Summer Marathon: Arctic Embers
timeline.detail: Shiny Snom debuts via GO Pass tasks and eggs, with boosted-shiny Ponyta, Slugma, Snover, and Vanillite alternating daily; free Timed Research expires Aug 10 at 8pm local and event pass rewards by Aug 12 at 8pm.

timeline.title: Fire and Ice Hatch Day
timeline.detail: Hatch Smoochum and Magby from 2km eggs at half hatch distance with boosted shiny odds and 2x hatch Candy; Larvesta possible from 5km eggs, claim the Timed Research Incubator by 5pm local.

timeline.title: Choose Your Path: Venom and Vines
timeline.detail: Pick your Explore, Catch, or Battle path again for a week of tailored Timed Research; claim everything before Aug 17 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Nickit Community Day
timeline.detail: Catch Shiny-boosted Nickit with 3x catch Stardust and evolve it by 9pm local for Thievul with Icy Wind; optional $1.99 Special Research adds Special Background encounters.

timeline.title: Ultra Unlock: Water Festival
timeline.detail: Arrokuda, Barraskewda, and Cramorant debut alongside Shiny Ducklett and Dewpider boosts; catch bonuses climb to 4x XP and 5x Stardust by Aug 22-24, event pass rewards expire Aug 26 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Starmie Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: Mega Starmie debuts in Super Mega Raids with boosted shiny odds and up to 6 free Raid Passes from Gym spins; optional $4.99 ticket raises that to 14 plus Rare Candy XL per catch.

timeline.title: Pokemon XP and 2026 Worlds
timeline.detail: Worlds-themed event runs Aug 25 at 10am to Aug 30 at 8pm local; full details not yet announced, check back before it starts.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local this season; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6am-9pm local
Thu Jul 30: Spotlight Hour, Bidoof, 2x transfer Candy
Thu Aug 6: Spotlight Hour, Delibird, 2x catch Stardust
Thu Aug 13: Spotlight Hour, Wurmple, 2x evolution XP
Thu Aug 20: Spotlight Hour, Magikarp, 2x catch XP
Thu Aug 27: Spotlight Hour, Mankey, 2x catch Candy
Max Mondays: Jul 27 Feebas, Aug 3 Magmar, Aug 10 Beldum, Aug 17 Magikarp, Aug 24 Hitmontop (all Dynamax)

5-star raids: Solgaleo through Jul 28; Kyurem Jul 29 - Aug 4; Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf Aug 5-11 (Azelf in the Americas, all three in the Aug 5 Raid Hour); Groudon Aug 12-18; Lunala Aug 19-25; Regirock, Regice, and Registeel Aug 26 - Sep 8
Shadow Raids (weekends): Shadow Palkia through Aug 4, then Shadow Giratina (Altered) Aug 5 - Sep 8, shiny possible
Mega Raids: Salamence through Jul 28, Aggron Jul 29 - Aug 4, Blaziken Aug 5-11, Garchomp Aug 12-18, Swampert Aug 19-25, Gyarados Aug 26 - Sep 8

GO Battle League (flips Tuesdays 1pm PDT): Great League + Master Premier Jul 28 - Aug 4 (4x win Stardust), Ultra League + Weather Cup Aug 4-11, Master League + Evolution Cup Aug 11-18 (4x win Stardust), Great League + Scroll Cup Aug 18-25, GL/UL/ML Aug 25 - Sep 1 (4x win Stardust)
just_past_window: Mon Aug 31: Max Monday, Dynamax Eevee
Sep 1, 1pm PDT: GO Battle League flips to GL/UL/ML Mega Edition with 4x win Stardust
Sep 5-6: GO Pass: August uncapped GO Points weekend
Sep 8, 10am local: Forever Forward season and GO Pass: August rank earning end
Sep 10, 10am local: GO Pass: August rewards expire, claim before then

games.typical_lead_time: in-game events announced only 4-7 days ahead; DLC and update news months ahead

timeline.title: Zorua's Hide-and-Sneak Contest
timeline.detail: Find Zorua at a rebuilt Pokemon Center and race hide-and-sneak courses for prizes including a trophy and Rare Pokemetal; ends Jul 27 at 4:59am local.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Chansey Plant
timeline.detail: Enter code P0K0P1AGARDENS at any Pokemon Center PC (Mystery Gift, Get with Code/Password) for a placeable Chansey Plant; codes are region free, valid through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the Ditto Rug at any Pokemon Center PC via the Get via Internet option, no code needed; available through Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass
timeline.detail: The three-part Expansion Pass is on the eShop now and includes a dynamic Ditto print recipe plus a 30 rare Pokemetal ingots code if bought by Aug 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Free update: Dive
timeline.detail: A free August update lets all players learn Dive to explore, build, and plant on the ocean floor; requires the Bleak Beach environment request, jump, and Surf.
timeline.estimate_basis: Official window is August 2026; no specific day announced as of Jul 24

timeline.title: Expansion Pass Part 1: Bubbly Basin
timeline.detail: Part 1 adds an underwater town with new furniture, outfits, and sea Pokemon (Popplio, Mudkip, Corphish lines, Manaphy); requires Dive.
timeline.estimate_basis: Official window is August 2026; no specific day announced as of Jul 24

timeline.title: Bubbly Basin demo at Worlds
timeline.detail: Play a Bubbly Basin demo at the Nintendo booth during PokemonXP and the 2026 Pokemon World Championships in San Francisco, badged attendees only.

just_past_window: Aug 29-30: PokemonXP and the 2026 Pokemon World Championships continue in San Francisco, Bubbly Basin demo playable at the Nintendo booth
